mapper.insert: INSERT INTO javbus_genre (id, name, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE name = VALUES(name)

INSERT IGNORE INTO javbus_movie_genre (movie_id, genre_id) VALUES
(#{movieId}, #{item.id})
mapper.select: SELECT jg.name FROM javbus_movie jm LEFT JOIN javbus_movie_genre jmg ON jm.id = jmg.movie_id LEFT JOIN javbus_genre jg ON jmg.genre_id = jg.id WHERE jm.code = #{code}
